newRows: | p-68be2ae3 | **`fgos doctor --fix` is all-or-nothing and can disturb working configs.** Owner report (2026-10-16): `--fix` hangs, and has damaged configs that were working. Code facts: `--fix` runs every registered fix (22 today, `src/setup/registrations.mjs` `registerFix`), including writes into other tools' configs (`codex-hook-wired`, `agy-hook-wired`, `omp-hook-wired`, `pi-hook-wired`, `agy-permissions-configured`, `claude-plugin-marketplace`) and cleanup (`confinement-orphaned-resources-reaped`, `credential-copies-retained`); there is no way to run one fix, no dry run, no backup. The JSON writers skip a malformed file (`src/setup/agent-hooks.mjs:107-108`) but otherwise rewrite the whole file with `JSON.stringify` (`agent-hooks.mjs:35-37`), so formatting and anything outside the touched key are re-serialized. Owner expectation: a fix only repairs what is wrong, keeps every existing setting, and when a file is syntactically broken it reports the syntax error (file, line, column) instead of guessing. | `fgos doctor --fix <check-id>` runs one fix; `--fix --dry-run` prints the exact change per file; every fix that edits a file makes a minimal key-level edit, keeps a timestamped backup, and leaves unrelated keys, ordering and formatting intact (golden tests on real-world config samples); a file that does not parse is reported with file, line and column and left untouched; each fix has a time limit and reports which fix is still running instead of hanging | proposed | — |

| p-7eb9e65b | **fgOS and AgentKit (`ak`) overwrite each other's registrations.** Observed 2026-10-16 in this repo: installing the `ak` engineer kit for both `claude-code` and `omp` targets wrote the same rule set into `.claude/rules/*.md` and into an `AGENTKIT-OMP` block in `AGENTS.md` (read twice by Claude through `@AGENTS.md`, about 17 KB), and re-appended about 19 hooks into `.claude/settings.json` in its raw form next to the guarded form fgOS had rewritten them to (commit `036884908`), so each hook fires twice; `statusLine` points at paths that do not exist. Cause: two installers each assume they own `settings.json` and the instruction files, and each compares hook commands by exact string. Related doctrine: `docs/coexistence.md` (territory, one conductor per session, Known Gaps). | A written ownership contract between fgOS and other kit installers: each tool owns named files or marked blocks (e.g. fgOS hooks in `.claude/settings.json`, kit hooks in `.claude/settings.local.json` or a kit-owned block), neither rewrites the other's entries, and hook identity is the script path, not the command string; `fgos doctor` reports duplicate hook registrations and instruction blocks loaded twice (reuse `core/skills/instruction-audit/scripts/instruction-audit.mjs` logic) and `--fix` removes only fgOS's own duplicates; `docs/coexistence.md` Known Gaps updated; re-running `ak kit install` and `fgos setup` in either order leaves no duplicates (test) | proposed | — |
